_comment: Per-platform hardware constants for hap_lib.py -- NOT distributed with the
public release. Fill every value from the official hardware documentation
(https://www.hiascend.com/document) for your devices, then save this file
All three platform blocks below are required (the scripts compute all
three platforms). cube / vec_basic take one entry per dtype the unit
supports (e.g. float16 / bfloat16 / float32 / int8 / ...) at the
datasheet peak rate; replace the '<dtype>' placeholders.
vec_basic MUST include a 'float32' entry: it is the fallback rate for
dtypes without an entry of their own (see hap_lib.vec_rate).
Units: hbm/l2 in bytes/s; l2cap in bytes; cube in FLOP/s; vec_basic and
cast_rate in element-op/s; sfu_factor/div_factor as fractions of basic.
hap_lib validates the file on load and reports exactly what is missing.
